📈 Section 1: Accuracy Cross-Benchmark Analysis & Distribution Shift

A central objective of this research is examining the accuracy transition between standard test benches and modern adversarial evasion sets. Traditional evaluation benchmarks often report inflated 95%+ accuracy because they pit blatant textbook scams against pristine shopping receipts.

In ScamOrLegit V3, the model is evaluated zero-shot with in-context vector RAG (no weights are updated via backpropagation), meaning the score shift is not classical weight memorization, but an authentic reflection of data distribution complexity:

Figure ACC-1: Comprehensive Cross-Benchmark Accuracy, Recall, Precision, and F1 Metrics across 4 Evaluation Regimes.

Notice that across both the Fresh Unseen Benchmark (96.67%) and the Adversarial Stress Test (84.00%), operating at decision threshold Θ = 60 provides optimal classification balance.

Figure ACC-2: Overall Accuracy, F1-Score, Precision, and Recall vs. Risk Score Decision Threshold (Θ ∈ [10, 90]).
Figure ACC-3: Domain-Level Accuracy Breakdown: Comparing V2 Deterministic Engine vs. V3 Semantic Hybrid across 10 Operational Threat Sectors.
🔍 Section 2: Fresh Unseen Benchmark Results (N=30)

The Fresh Unseen Benchmark was engineered to validate generalization on newly emerged attack vectors (CBI digital arrest, FASTag deactivation, electricity disconnection extortion) alongside clean consumer notifications.

Figure 1: Fresh Unseen Confusion Matrix (N=30) at Decision Boundary Θ = 60 (Accuracy: 96.67%, Precision: 100.00%).

V2 vs. V3 Comparison: While the pure heuristic engine achieved only 26.67% recall on these modern attacks, the V3 Semantic Hybrid Engine intercepted 93.33% of threats—a +66.67% recall lift while maintaining zero false positives.

Figure 2: Fresh Unseen Threat Detection: V2 Rule-Based Heuristics vs. V3 Semantic Hybrid Engine.

🛡️ Section 3: Large-Scale Adversarial Stress Test (N=100)

The Large-Scale Adversarial Benchmark evaluated 100 challenging cases: 50 sophisticated scams designed to evade heuristics (zero-urgency grooming, subtle typosquatting, cloud OAuth lures) and 50 ambiguous legitimate messages (aggressive collection notices, medical diagnostic PDF links with 48h limit, P2P expense splits).

Figure 6: Large-Scale Adversarial Confusion Matrix (N=100) with 84.00% Accuracy, 86.96% Precision, and 80.00% Recall.

On these 50 adversarial attacks, the V2 rule engine failed completely, catching only 10 attacks (20.00% recall). The V3 Semantic Hybrid Engine caught 40 of 50 attacks, representing a +60.00% semantic lift.

Figure 7: Detection Lift on 50 Adversarial Scams: V2 Rule Engine (20.0%) vs. V3 Semantic Hybrid (80.0%).
Figure 8: Bimodal Score Distribution Across 100 Adversarial and Ambiguous Cases.
Figure 9: Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) and Precision-Recall (PR) Curves for N=100.
Figure 10: Mean Latency Attribution: Local Heuristics & RAG (385 ms) vs. Foundation LLM (4,420 ms).
🔬 Section 4: Root-Cause Qualitative Error Analysis

Understanding error modes across 100 adversarial cases provides critical operational insight for enterprise deployment:

Type Sample ID Category Score Root Cause & Failure Mechanism
FN adv_scam_01 Soft Grooming Romance 30 Initial rapport building in pig-butchering attack. Zero URLs, zero urgency, and zero payment demands.
FN adv_scam_21 Financial Conversational Pivot 5 Polite discussion regarding relative at UBS trading gold without immediate links.
FN adv_scam_23 Disaster Relief UPI Trap 5 Exploits landslide sympathy with clean UPI handle lacking explicit extortion keywords.
FN adv_scam_28 Peer Verification Intercept 5 Pretexting as a friend asking for a code sent in error; mimics casual peer SMS.
FP adv_legit_03 Logistics Courier Tracking 65 External tracking URL + delivery rider OTP triggered the package scam heuristic.
FP adv_legit_04 Hospital Diagnostic Portal 60 48-hour expiration deadline + external link for confidential medical reports triggered urgency filters.
FP adv_legit_09 Corporate IT Password Expiry 75 3-day deadline + active directory password reset URL closely resembled credential harvesting.
FP adv_legit_34 Food Delivery Rider Update 65 Live arrival countdown + food delivery rider OTP triggered conservative heuristic alarm.
